note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (house rules of an imaginary building, jurisdiction unspecified). The route shown before and after the substitution is SUPPLIED by the author (routeBefore / routeAfter); the scene never decides whether a rule or an exception applies. With focusTarget 'condition' the holder on the condition plaque shows beforeValue → afterValue in place of rules.condition.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The magnifier lifts the parcel card's datum holder: 'Needs a signature' is struck and replaced by 'No signature needed'; as supplied, the marker tile flips to empty, the relation to the gate socket is withdrawn, the switch returns and the main route lights.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the datum inspected is the CONDITION on the gate plaque. 'The parcel needs a signature' is replaced by 'The parcel is marked fragile'; the author supplies the after state as pending, so the card's marker is covered, the relation is withdrawn and the wagon's route stays unset at the junction.

rules.general: Parcels are left at the front desk
rules.exception: Parcels meeting the condition go to the post room

issues: What changes on the board if the supplied condition is reworded?

presets.name: long-labels-stress
